mentions.name: heylife.ai
mentions.description: This app delivers proactive advice based on your calendar, tastes, hobbies, and location without you having to ask — e.g., transit tips when arriving in a city or preparation advice before a big soccer game. Work in progress includes sandboxing and scheduling of the advices, with a paid release planned this week.
mentions.problem: Advice apps typically require the user to ask first; this app gives advice proactively, before or when it is needed.
